summary: Conditionally normalizes a 3-component float vector (a2 -> a1). Computes squared length v5 and, when v5 >= dword_8D6180 (threshold global), scales the components by a Newton-Raphson refined reciprocal square root using globals dword_8D6184 (scale) and dword_8D6188 (subtractive constant); otherwise writes 0.0 to all three output components. Returns the output pointer a1.

operations.description: Seed result = a1 and load input components v3 = a2[1], v4 = a2[2].
Compute squared length v5 = a2[0]^2 + v3^2 + v4^2 over the three components.
Guard on v5 against global threshold: when dword_8D6180 <= v5 the vector is normalized, otherwise the output is zeroed.
Normalize branch: compute reciprocal square root v6 = 1.0 / fsqrt(v5).
Normalize branch: apply Newton-Raphson refinement v7 = dword_8D6184 * v6 * (dword_8D6188 - v5 * v6 * v6).
Normalize branch: store a1[0..2] = v7 * a2[0..2] for the three components.
Zero branch: store a1[0..2] = 0.0 for the three components.
